parsed.reason: The message tells the parent plainly and in the first person that many texts arrived at once and Hale is not answering this one, and invites them to send it again. It does not promise an answer on resend, names no wait time, does not scold, and does not mention others. However, 'I can't promise a quick reply' and 'try someone else too' drift slightly toward support-desk framing and imply a possible later reply, so it loses a point.
